content.title: National Weather Service
content.text: This AfternoonCloudy early, then becoming mostly sunny, with a high near 50. Breezy, with a north wind 20 to 25 mph, with gusts as high as 40 mph. TonightMostly cloudy during the early evening, then gradual clearing, with a low around 24. Blustery, with a north wind 15 to 20 mph decreasing to 5 to 10 mph after midnight. Winds could gust as high as 25 mph. FridaySunny, with a high near 46. North northwest wind 5 to 10 mph increasing to 10 to 15 mph in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 30 mph. Friday NightMostly clear, with a low around 26. Northwest wind 5 to 10 mph becoming south southeast after midnight. SaturdayMostly sunny, with a high near 61. Breezy, with a south southwest wind 15 to 25 mph, with gusts as high as 35 mph. Saturday NightPartly cloudy, with a low around 39. South wind around 10 mph, with gusts as high as 20 mph. SundayMostly sunny, with a high near 75.Sunday NightMostly clear, with a low around 43.MondayPartly sunny, with a high near 69.Monday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 45.TuesdayMostly cloudy, with a high near 74.Tuesday NightMostly cloudy, with a low around 41.WednesdayA 30 percent chance of showers. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 56.
